common.promptStandard: Purpose: project-authored wall information board and replaceable Chinese graphic content. Specification: wall board envelope 1.00m x 0.70m x 0.05m with fixed 0.88m x 0.56m information face, and 1100 x 700 sRGB content images. Units are metres, up is +Y, forward is +Z, wall contact is the centred back. Installation: board is wall-mounted information-board, content is an information-surface child with centred origin and no blocking/use points. Budget: deterministic CPU-only BoxGeometry frames and Pillow PNG content with no network fetch. State: content visibility only, no timer. Source/export: project-authored parameters, local Noto Sans SC font, Pillow 12.1.0 and Three.js GLTFExporter/GLTFLoader readback.
